title: Communist Party invokes Jiang’s legacy in call to rally round Xi’s leadership
text:
Article in People’s Daily marking the former leader’s centenary stressed the importance of unity when navigating ‘rough waters’

“Under the party’s third-generation leadership with Comrade Jiang Zemin at its core, China calmly responded to a set of international emergencies which mattered to China’s sovereignty and security, and weathered difficulties and risks in political and economic sectors as well as natural disasters … ensuring that the ship of reform, opening-up and modernisation always forged ahead along the right course,” the article said.

Other events commemorating the legacy of Jiang, who died in 2022 at the age of 96, include a recent 12-part television documentary, commemorative postage stamps, a symposium to discuss his thinking about defence and a gathering in Beijing on Monday – the anniversary of his birth – where Xi will give a speech.
